about.title: About Legendary Collection 5D's Mega Pack
paragraphs: Legendary Collection 5D's Mega Pack is a Yu-Gi-Oh! TCG tin released on 23 October 2014, in the ARC-V era. It has 256 cards, and with the 4 other rarities there are 260 to collect in all.
Choose what you’re collecting: the Standard set (the 256 cards, each in its main rarity) or the Master set (all 260, adding the 4 other rarities).

This free checklist lets you tick off the cards you own, count spare copies for trading, see your progress by rarity and plan your binder pages. It works on phones and computers, even offline, and your collection stays on your device.
Card details and images come from YGOPRODeck, and prices from TCGplayer.
